baseline.core_rule: The existing 45-reference Core/Concept-Paper corpus remains the Core regression fixture and is not reclassified or rewritten by PASS 4.

architecture_rule: Do not replace the Core 45-reference array merely to make the global library larger. Preserve Core reference identity and expose the additional literature through a separate deduplicated global-library layer. Production runtime/QA must distinguish core_reference_count=45 from global_reference_count=70.
selection_rule: New sources were selected because Extended/Outcomes population creates evidence territories not adequately represented by the original Core-focused bibliography. Inclusion supports adjacent mechanisms, construct comparators, measurement precedents or validation methods; it does not validate P-120 modules.

deduplication.final_deduplication_gate: Re-run DOI and bibliographic deduplication immediately before production registry/library activation.

claim_boundary: A larger bibliography reflects broader scientific coverage after Extended/Outcomes integration; it must never be presented as a count-based proof of validity or as a marketing metric detached from evidence roles.
